from.place: 09N2 proof: Since the fraction fields of B and A are the same, the finite module A/B is supported on the closed points of B, so m_B^n A is contained in B

title: A finite intermediate integral ring has a conductor power
statement: Let B be a Noetherian semilocal domain [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of Krull dimension 1 [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] with Jacobson radical m_B, let K be its fraction field, and let A be a finite B-algebra contained in K. If A and B have the same fraction field, then there exists an integer n>0 such that m_B^n A is contained in B.
